motif: One glowing Seiva Clara (#8ECC2D) lantern-mushroom cap on each building, set against a sweet-rust plate trim. The cap is the race's single repeated shape.

buildings.why: The blind guardian is a closed trunk drum with its arms folded across the front, so it reads as a solid cylinder.
Chain of Growth, Life and Eternity. Eternity is the biggest dome, with a moss mantle and a ring of roots around it.
The crown is permanently bent downwind, so the whole building leans.
First link of the Growth chain: a cut stool with one cap, which grows into the dome.
Chain of Slumber and Hibernation. Hibernation is the same low den mouth, larger and taller, with half-open rust doors.
The grown-back closed crown under dense moss is a bigger dome, and the root-tube is a small side feature.
A hollow den trunk with a low, wide dark mouth.
Ranks of shelves with lantern caps and sap flasks stack up as terraces inside the tree.
It is the race's only tower, so it is the tallest vertical piece. The iron body is fortified.
A branch platform sits on a split master trunk, with the root-tube running down the stalk.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Chain of Furbolg Hut, Enigma and Abode. Enigma's tent peak and watch mast form the peak cluster.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: The chapel version of the hut, with a root mast beside the roof peak.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: The base cabin is a small tent peak and a door pole. Its colour differs from its neighbours in the build order.
Roots pass clear through the split block, which leaves a hole that reads as a gate.
Chain of Spider Egg Clutch, Nest and Hatchery. Cocoons half buried in mud begin the pit, and the Nest makes it a trench.
The hatchery is a master cocoon split open inside the pit rim, in a lighter colour than its neighbours.
The nest is a root pit with a web between the rims and two caps marking the mouth.
